controller: One program simultaneously controls the devices
semantic_rule: Events issued by the common controller represent the same experimental instant across devices
ttl_rule: Different TTL levels, polarities and codes are retained as device-native values and are not assigned clinical meaning from numeric level alone
clock_rule: Device-local clocks and offsets remain explicit; common-controller semantics do not by themselves prove a unique per-record offset or exact swallowing time
dose_rule: Protocol-relative event time may be used only when the event sequence is uniquely anchored; do not label a protocol onset as exact ingestion time without an individual ingestion timestamp
failure_policy: Ambiguous, missing or periodic event matches remain unverified and are excluded from dose-relative association
t_stage_rule: Exclude filename T acquisition stages; retain VAS-cell T as a participant termination marker
